sentences.text: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners files a memo seeking withdrawal of the petition.

The memo so filed reads as follows:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL The petitioners have filed the above petition challenging the FIR before this Hon'ble Court.
But subsequently the respondents filed Charge sheet against the accused in CC No.6903/2023.
The accused No.11 Krishnappa has filed Crl. Petition No.987/2025 challenging the Charge sheet before this Hon'ble Court.
Therefore, the above petition may kindly be dismissed as withdrawn liberty to peruse Crl. Petition No.987/2025 in the interest of justice and equity."
In terms of memo, the petition is disposed as withdrawn.
